MRI Safety Information
The Aster Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5 Tesla and 3.0 Tesla only
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg
Device Configuration Stimulation OFF
MR image artifact: the artifact may extend up to 15 mm beyond the implant.
